deep.reconstruction:
Context: on the previous folio Riemann expresses quotients of square roots of contact curves (the 'x,y,z,t' attached to odd characteristics; for p=3 these are bitangents) by theta quotients. On this folio he counts theta characteristics and pairs of them for general genus p.

(1) Heading: 'Anzahl der Systeme von halben [Perioden/Charakteristiken], für welche die theta nicht verschwinden: alpha_p; für welche die theta verschwinden: beta_p.' So alpha_p counts the even half-period characteristics (theta[e](0) not identically zero) and beta_p the odd ones (theta[e](0)=0).

(2) Recursion. Genus 1 has 3 even and 1 odd characteristic, so alpha_1=3 and beta_1=1. Adjoining one more genus-1 block, the parity of a sum adds, giving
 alpha_{p+1} = 3 alpha_p + beta_p,
 beta_{p+1} = 3 beta_p + alpha_p.
Hence:
- alpha_{p+1}+beta_{p+1} = 4(alpha_p+beta_p), so alpha_p+beta_p = 2^{2p};
- alpha_{p+1}-beta_{p+1} = 2(alpha_p-beta_p), so alpha_p-beta_p = 2^p.
Therefore alpha_p = 2^{p-1}(2^p+1) and beta_p = 2^{p-1}(2^p-1).

(3) Pairs of odd characteristics.
- beta_p(beta_p-1)/2 = 2^{p-2}(2^p-1)(2^{2p-1}-2^{p-1}-1).
- Using beta_p-1 = 2^{2p-1}-2^p+2^{p-1}-1 = (2^{p-1}-1)(2^p+1), this becomes 2^{p-2}(2^{p-1}-1)(2^{2p}-1).
- The factor 2^{2p}-1 is the number of nonzero half periods w. So each nonzero w is the sum of exactly 2^{p-2}(2^{p-1}-1) unordered pairs of odd characteristics. This division is my reading; it is what the next line states as the number of products of two (beta).
- For p=3 this gives 378 = 63·6: the 63 Steiner complexes of 6 pairs of bitangents.

(4) Pairs of even characteristics (lower left). Riemann has alpha_p - 1 = 2^{2p-1}+2^{p-1}-1 = 2^{2p-1}+2^p-2^{p-1}-1 = (2^{p-1}+1)(2^p-1). Hence alpha_p(alpha_p-1)/2 = 2^{p-2}(2^{p-1}+1)(2^{2p}-1), i.e. 2^{p-2}(2^{p-1}+1) even pairs per nonzero w (10 for p=3). The page shows only the per-w factor 2^{p-2}(2^{p-1}+1).

(5) A further, only partly legible count (numbers of products of 2 or 3 odd thetas with a parity condition, and products with alpha). Riemann writes three expressions, which are algebraically identical (my verification):
 N_p = (beta_p-1)(beta_{p-1}+2)/3 + 1 = (beta_p-1)(beta_{p-1}-1)/3 + beta_p = beta_p beta_{p-1}/3 + (2 beta_p - beta_{p-1} + 1)/3.
Values: N_1=1, N_2=6, N_3=73, N_4=1191. He also records beta_p beta_{p-1}/3 separately (2, 56, 1120 for p=2,3,4). The precise combinatorial object counted cannot be read with certainty.

(6) Right column: attempt to put N_p into powers of 2.
- He expands (beta_p-1)(beta_{p-1}-1)/3 + beta_p = (2^{p-1}-1)(2^p+1)(2^{p-2}-1)(2^{p-1}+1)/3 + 2^{p-1}(2^p-1).
- He regroups via (2^{p-1}-1)(2^{p-1}+1) = 2^{2p-2}-1 and (2^p+1)(2^{p-2}-1) = (2^{2p-2}-1) - 3·2^{p-2}.
- This gives (2^{2p-2}-1)^2/3 - (2^{2p-2}-1)2^{p-2} + 2^{2p-1} - 2^{p-1} = (2^{2p-2}-1)^2/3 - 2^{p-2}(2^{2p-2}-2^{p+1}+1).
- Side identity: 2^{2p}+2^{2p-1}-3 = (2^{2p}-1) + 2(2^{2p-2}-1).
- Further rearrangements (some crossed out, one a geometric series 2^{2p-4}+2^{2p-6}+...+1) end in 2^{2p-4}-2^{p-3}+1, which equals (beta_{p-1}+2)/2.

(7) Bottom right: beta_p - beta_{p-1} = 2^{2p-1}-2^{p-1}-2^{2p-3}+2^{p-2} = 3·2^{2p-3}-2^{p-2} = 2^{p-2}(3·2^{p-1}-1).

(8) Bottom left fragment: sqrt(yz/(xt)) = phi_{2p-4}/phi'_{2p-4}. A quotient of square roots of four contact functions is a rational function, written as a quotient of two curves of degree 2p-4 on the degree-(2p-2) plane model of the previous page.
errors: No substantive mathematical errors found in the legible steps; the algebraic identities all check.
The transcription's factorization alpha_p-1 = (2^{p-1})(2^p+1) is wrong; the page (and correct algebra) gives (2^{p-1}+1)(2^p-1).

The lower-left line rendered as alpha_p alpha_{p-1}/2 = 2^{p-2}(2^{p-1}+1) is not literally true (for p=3, alpha_3 alpha_2/2 = 180). It must be the per-half-period count alpha_p(alpha_p-1)/(2(2^{2p}-1)) = 2^{p-2}(2^{p-1}+1). Either a slip by Riemann or a misreading.
Several intermediate lines in the right column are crossed out or ambiguous; their equalities cannot all be confirmed. The legible ones are consistent.

results.what: Number of even and odd half-period theta characteristics in genus p, via the recursion alpha_{p+1}=3alpha_p+beta_p, beta_{p+1}=3beta_p+alpha_p
results.modern_name: Count of even/odd theta characteristics: 2^{p-1}(2^p+1) even, 2^{p-1}(2^p-1) odd
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann (posthumous genus-3/Abelian function fragments, edited by Weber 1876); standard in Weber, Frobenius, Krazer

results.what: Number of unordered pairs of odd (resp. even) characteristics with given nonzero sum w: 2^{p-2}(2^{p-1}-1) (resp. 2^{p-2}(2^{p-1}+1))
results.modern_name: Steiner complexes / pairs of theta characteristics with fixed difference (quadratic forms on F_2^{2p})
results.usually_credited_to: Steiner and Hesse for p=3 (63 complexes of 6 bitangent pairs); general p in Weber/Frobenius/Clebsch–Gordan era

results.what: Closed-form manipulation of an auxiliary count N_p=(beta_p-1)(beta_{p-1}+2)/3+1, given in three equivalent forms

deep.surprise_reason: The even/odd characteristic counts and the pairing counts per half period are classical and known to be in Riemann's circle (his posthumous genus-3 work). This page is routine combinatorial bookkeeping toward that theory.

checkable.asserts: The two expressions for N_p coincide

transcription_corrections: 'alpha_p alpha_{p-1}/2' is probably alpha_p(alpha_p-1)/2 (reduced per half period to 2^{p-2}(2^{p-1}+1)).
In the line on products of two (beta), the count is 2^{p-2}(2^{p-1}-1), not 2^{p-2}(2^p-1).
'(beta_p-1)(beta_{p-1})/3 + beta_p' should be (beta_p-1)(beta_{p-1}-1)/3 + beta_p; it matches the right-column expansion and equals the other two forms.
In the right-column first line, the factors are (2^{p-1}-1)(2^p+1)(2^{p-2}-1)(2^{p-1}+1)/3 and the added term is 2^{p-1}(2^p-1) (= beta_p).
Heading likely 'Anzahl der Systeme von halben Perioden' (half-period characteristics).
Last line likely sqrt(yz/(xt)) = phi_{2p-4}/phi'_{2p-4} (quotient of adjoint curves), not 'qz'.
